source: Serena language support and configuration docs
usage: Project setup and brownfield setup should read this index when Serena is selected, detect matching languages, run the listed mise_use commands in the project root, then create or update .serena/project.yml with serena project create. Only write language keys supported by the installed Serena runtime; docs-only keys are noted below.

runtime_validation.verified_command: solidlsp.ls_config.Language enum from the installed serena-agent Python 3.13 tool environment
runtime_validation.setup_rule: Do not add docs-only language keys to .serena/project.yml until the installed Serena runtime exposes them. Use the broader companion language instead when possible, such as typescript for Angular/HTML-adjacent projects.

languages.server: Microsoft AL language server from the Business Central VS Code extension
languages.notes: Serena downloads the VS Code extension by default.
Current docs list Angular, but installed Serena 1.2.0 does not expose the angular language key. Do not add this to project.yml until runtime support is present; use typescript for now.
Experimental and must be explicitly listed in project.yml. ansible in PATH is required for full functionality.
Setting ls_specific_settings.bash.ls_path can point Serena at the mise executable.
Provide compile_commands.json at the repository root for best results.
Experimental alternative to clangd; prefer cpp/clangd unless a project explicitly needs ccls.
Requires a JVM runtime.
Crystalline must be available on PATH; go-to-definition support is limited upstream.
.NET 10 or higher is required. Serena downloads the Roslyn language server from NuGet by default.
Optional fallback for C#; prefer csharp/Roslyn.
Serena can download a Dart SDK version, but project setup should use mise when Dart is a project language.
Elixir installation is required; Expert is downloaded automatically.
Elm compiler is required.
Docs mark this experimental and require beam plus erlang_ls; install erlang_ls manually if mise has no suitable backend.
Docs require fortls. The Serena tool environment may already include it, but project setup should make the dependency explicit when Fortran is detected.
.NET 8 or higher is required.
gopls must be installed.
Requires a user-provided groovy-language-server.jar configured through project or environment settings.
Serena locates HLS via ghcup, stack, or system PATH. Project may also need stack or cabal.
Requires Haxe compiler 3.4.0 or higher and Node.js.
On macOS the server may need Rust to build from source. Used for HLSL, GLSL, and WGSL.
Current docs list HTML, but installed Serena 1.2.0 does not expose the html language key. Do not add this to project.yml until runtime support is present.
Requires a JDK.
Requires Julia.
Experimental and must be explicitly listed in project.yml.
Docs describe the server as pre-alpha.
Requires lean and lake via elan; run lake build before use.
Serena downloads lua-language-server when it cannot use an existing installation.
Serena downloads luau-lsp if it is not available on PATH.
Experimental and must be explicitly listed in project.yml.

languages.server: MathWorks MATLAB language server from VS Code extension
languages.notes: Requires MATLAB R2021b or later; set matlab_path or MATLAB_PATH if auto-detection is insufficient.
No external dependency required.
Requires nixd. Use the project platform's Nix tooling if mise cannot install it cleanly.
Requires opam and ocaml-lsp-server; see Serena OCaml setup guide.
Set PP/FPCDIR or project settings for source navigation.
Requires Perl::LanguageServer installation.
Set INTELEPHENSE_LICENSE_KEY for premium features if needed.
Alternative to Intelephense; requires PHP 8.1 or higher.
Requires pwsh available locally.
Serena defaults to the Python executable running Serena. Use ls_path for a project interpreter override if needed.
Alternative Python backend exposed by installed Serena. Prefer python/Pyright unless a project explicitly needs Jedi behavior.
Alternative Python backend exposed by installed Serena. Treat as experimental unless a project explicitly chooses ty.
mise has no r tool registry entry. Install rig with mise, use rig to install R, then install the R languageserver package.
Installed Serena exposes the rego language key, but no verified mise install command was found here. Use project platform tooling to install the Rego language server when needed.
Serena installs ruby-lsp when no project-local or global ruby-lsp is available.
Legacy alternative; prefer ruby/ruby-lsp.
Serena prefers rustup which rust-analyzer, then rustup component add rust-analyzer, then PATH.
Requires Scala project setup; see Serena Scala guide.
Current docs list SCSS/Sass/CSS, but installed Serena 1.2.0 does not expose the scss language key. Do not add this to project.yml until runtime support is present.
Experimental; works best with foundry.toml or hardhat.config.js.
Requires Swift toolchain with sourcekit-lsp.
Serena downloads Verible if it cannot use a system installation.
Terraform itself must be installed and available in PATH.
Experimental in Serena; can be explicitly listed in project.yml.
Use for JavaScript and TypeScript. Configure additional_workspace_folders in project.yml for cross-package reference discovery.

Requires Node.js 18 or higher and npm; supports Vue 3.x.
